description: Department of Local Government Sabaragamuwa Province -  The name of the mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, Deputy Chairmen for each Local Governments in Sabaragamuwa Province
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically publishes the names of elected local government officials (Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, Deputy Chairmen) as required under Section 66 C. (1) of the Local Authorities Election Ordinance. The content directly relates to electoral processes and the declaration of election results for local government institutions, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than general government personnel appointments.
